title: Walk Through Ephesus
subtitle: The city of Paul’s day, around AD 52–55
intro: Paul’s letter has just reached the church in Ephesus and is being read aloud in a crowded house. An older member turns to you: “You weren’t here in Paul’s years. Come, I’ll show you the city as it was.”
howTouch: Left thumb: walk. Drag anywhere else: look around. Tap the map to open it.
howKeys: W A S D or arrow keys: walk. Shift: jog. Click and drag: look around. M: map.
phaseNote: Preview: the landmarks and their plaques are in; people and the story come next.
mapNote: Dashed circles mark places whose real location is unknown. We have placed them where they plausibly could have been.
errorNoWebGL: Sorry, this device or browser can't show 3D graphics. Try a newer browser such as Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge.
plaqueHint: Tap the glowing marker, or press Read, to learn about this place.
plaqueHintKeys: Click the glowing marker, or press E, to learn about this place.
